reason: I always forget pills at home, so a sachet I can toss in my gym bag with the 2 capsules already counted is actually useful. At $24.99 for the first box I'd give it a try, but only one box.
objection: Two capsules every day is still two capsules, and I'm not sure I'd remember to take the sachet in the evening either. I don't know if magnesium would do anything noticeable for me.
